from scipy import ndimage
def solve(g):
    g=g.copy(); H,W=g.shape
    marks=[(y,x,g[y,x]) for y,x in zip(*np.where((g!=0)&(g!=1)))]
    solid=g.copy()
    for y,x,c in marks: solid[y,x]=1
    # interior: 3x3 all 1
    ones=(solid==1).astype(int)
    cnt=ndimage.uniform_filter(ones,3,mode='constant')
    interior=(cnt==1)&(solid==1)
    for y,x,c in marks: interior[y,x]=True  # marker counts as interior (it was 1 originally)
    # components of solid
    lab,n=ndimage.label(solid)  # 4-conn
    out=g.copy()
    for y,x,c in marks: out[y,x]=c
    for l in range(1,n+1):
        comp=(lab==l)
        cs=[c for y,x,c in marks if comp[y,x]]
        if len(cs)==1:
            out[interior&comp]=cs[0]
    return out
pred=solve(din)
print('exact match:', np.array_equal(pred,dout))
print('mismatch count', (pred!=dout).sum())
for y,x in zip(*np.where(pred!=dout)): print(y,x,din[y,x],dout[y,x],pred[y,x])
